SciRIFF includes 137K demonstrations for 54 tasks ... spanning five broad scientific literature understanding task categories: information extraction, summarization, question answering, claim verification, and classification.

LLMs have the potential to advance scientific progress by helping researchers navigate and draw insights from the scientific literature. To accomplish these tasks, LLMs must be able to reliably follow a range of instructions—e.g. to extract information, summarize content, or answer questions—when given research articles as input.
